services.desc: This intimate One Bedroom Luxury Cabin is exclusively for 2 people and is perfect for a romantic getaway in the mountains! Birchwood features a hot tub on the screened in porch, perfect for relaxing while viewing nature at its best! It features the following amenities: Queen Bedroom Bathroom with Shower Fully-Equipped Kitchen Electric Fireplace Cable TV / Wi-Fi Screened-in Porch with Hot Tub Air Conditioning / Electric Heat Outside Fire Ring & Picnic Table Guests must provide linens and towels. blurb: Wonderful memories await you at Ole Mink Farm Recreation Resort. For over sixty years, the Irons Family has been hosting getaways for families and friends to make memories that last a lifetime. We invite you to experience “Seclusion so close to home” at our beautiful resort. Offering Seasonal Campsites as well as Luxury Log Cabins and Camping Cabins, there is something for everyone!
